definitions.explanation: A chart showing days, weeks, and months of a year.

notes:
カレンダー is a loanword from English "calendar."

TYPES OF CALENDARS:
- {壁掛|かべか}けカレンダー: wall calendar
- {卓上|たくじょう}カレンダー: desk calendar
- {日|ひ}めくりカレンダー: daily tear-off calendar
- カレンダーアプリ: calendar app

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- カレンダー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at the calendar
- カレンダー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}む→書き込む：04599_kakikomu⟧: to write on the calendar
- カレンダー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掛|か}ける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to hang a calendar
- カレンダー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦めくる→捲る：02310_mekuru⟧: to turn the calendar page

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧: date
- ⟦{曜日|ようび}→曜日：03877_youbi⟧: day of the week
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧: schedule, plan
- ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧: calendar (traditional)
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧カレンダー: yearly calendar

JAPANESE ALTERNATIVE: ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧ is the native Japanese word for calendar, often used for traditional calendars.
